validator: validate_snake() re-derives validity and length from the raw vertex sequence: range, distinctness, unit-Hamming steps, chord-freeness. Solver claims are never trusted.
pass_criteria: mean snake length across dims x seeds beats stochastic_beam at equal budget on the holdout split (unseen seeds, adds Q8)
candidate_interface: Write a Python module exposing exactly: solve(n: int, seed: int, budget: int) -> list[int]. Return a vertex sequence (integers in [0, 2**n)) forming an induced chord-free path in the hypercube Q_n, starting [0, 1, ...]. Consecutive vertices must differ in exactly one bit; NO two non-consecutive vertices may be adjacent. Length is scored as edges (len-1). budget counts candidate-extension evaluations your search may perform (charge yourself 1 per successor you generate/score); respect it. Use only the Python standard library. The harness re-validates every sequence; any violation scores NaN.
